policy.scope: Docker Desktop Linux; network none; client and server share 2CPU/4GiB

limits: Two immutable release IDs use the same qualified image/model; control transitions, not a model comparison.
Readiness/retirement observer faults and an owned active-process SIGKILL; no model corruption or host/daemon power-loss test.
Local Docker Desktop Linux, network none, no public traffic switching or zero-downtime claim.
Original Linux qualification is upstream evidence; no new full-fold quality or blind data.
RAM budget remains unmet; representative load, target-host recovery and production rollout remain separate.
Workflow YAML/policy are locally validated; no GitHub run, private runner or environment protection was configured here.
Constructed snapshot contexts and a finite local Linux matrix, not representative production traffic or a statistical SLO.
Wire disconnect differs from controlled ASGI-task cancellation; fixture faults are separate from original-model lifecycle evidence.
512MiB driver occupancy is bounded memory pressure, not actual OOM, CPU exhaustion or a remote dependency outage.
Same-model A/B local control is not public routing, zero downtime, native-host or daemon/power-loss recovery.
Preserved 2GiB RSS budget remains unmet; no model/quota/cache-default optimization or deployment authorization.
